cannot_claim: certified operational claim without the separate LCCP record

checkpoint_contract.checkpoint_loading: torch hub model structure with explicit public checkpoint state dictionaries for encoder and predictor
checkpoint_contract.official_benchmark_boundary: this packet uses the public checkpoint as a fixed carrier on a MiniGrid stream and does not reproduce the official V-JEPA2-AC benchmark protocol

claim_scope: same MiniGrid image/action stream as the BEDC native packet; V-JEPA2-AC encoder and action-conditioned predictor are loaded from the public Giant checkpoint; a linear alignment is fitted only on the train split for reporting the fixed-checkpoint latent-prediction evaluation

execution_contract.split_rule: single seeded transition stream; first train_count rows fit the linear alignment; remaining rows are held out for reporting

feature_contract.action_contract: one-hot MiniGrid action vector with an auxiliary action-count coordinate
feature_contract.alignment: ridge linear map fitted from predicted features to source features on the train split only
feature_contract.predicted_features: action-conditioned predictor pooled token features over the same transition video, action vector, and state vector
feature_contract.source_features: encoder pooled token features over the two-frame MiniGrid transition video
feature_contract.state_contract: agent position, visible key/door/goal indicators, nearest-object distance, and action-count coordinate
feature_contract.video_contract: two 256x256 RGB frames rendered from MiniGrid symbolic observations before and after the sampled action
